description: The Board-page features: officer-managed Events (data + UI + list/schedule integration), the per-account personal task tracker (task_completions data + checkbox + filter + viewer-dependent glow), and the Month calendar view. Grounded in design.md Data layer, Components -> Events/Personal tracker/Month calendar, and Error handling. Depends on FEAT-001 (tables/publication), FEAT-002 (types, pure fns, tokens), and FEAT-003 (App shell / Layout rendered via PageRouter).
steps: Events data: create src/data/useEvents.ts as useRealtimeTable<EventRow, EventItem>('events', rowToEvent) exactly like src/data/useTasks.ts. Extend src/data/mutations.ts with addEvent(input)/updateEvent(id, patch)/removeEvent(id) using classify/MutationResult, sending '' (not null) for empty location/notes and never checking client role.

Events UI: create src/components/EventBadge.tsx (token background per type + inline SVG icon in the Header icon style + text label; icons: school_event=calendar-star, quiz=clipboard-question, exam=document-check, presentation=presentation-screen) so type is never color-only. Create src/components/AddEventDialog.tsx: officer-only form opened from a new 'Add Event' button next to 'Add task' in TaskList (shown only when isOfficer); fields type <select>, title (required), subject <select> (optional '— none —'), CalendarField date, optional start/end <input type=time> (client enforces: end only if start present, end >= start), location, notes; submit via addEvent; shared Modal; no optimistic UI (reconciles via realtime like AddTaskDialog).

List integration: in src/components/TaskList.tsx merge tasks + events through the shared CalendarItem shape from calendar.ts with the design's explicit sort (datePart asc; kind-order tasks-before-events as tie-break; startTime asc nulls-last; title asc); React key `${kind}:${id}`; render events via EventBadge; event rows read-only for members with officer edit/remove affordances (RLS-backed). Wire useEvents into Layout and pass events to TaskList, ScheduleGrid, and MonthCalendar.

Schedule badge: in src/components/ScheduleCell.tsx render the upcoming-assessment corner marker when hasUpcomingAssessment(subject.id, events, today) — a shape/icon/token (--assess-badge) distinct from the pending dot, with sr-only '(assessment within 7 days)'. Thread events from Layout through ScheduleGrid to ScheduleCell.

Tracker data: factor a useRealtimeTableKeyed variant out of src/data/useRealtimeTable.ts taking keyOf(row) for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE reconcile (base useRealtimeTable stays id-keyed and its tests unaffected). Create src/data/useTaskCompletions.ts: session-aware, keyed on `${user_id}:${task_id}`, exposing completedTaskIds: Set<string> + raw rows; on sign-in/mount fetch own rows + subscribe; on sign-out tear down + reset the set to empty; re-key the effect on the session user id. Add src/data/useTaskCompletions.test.ts covering keyed reconcile + the session transitions (empty signed-out, populate on sign-in, reset on sign-out, re-key on user change).

Tracker mutations: extend src/data/mutations.ts with OPTIMISTIC markTaskDone(taskId, userId) (insert { user_id, task_id }) and unmarkTaskDone(taskId, userId) (delete().match({ user_id, task_id })), documented as the one deliberate optimistic exception; caller updates completedTaskIds immediately, reverts on error; realtime reconcile is idempotent on the Set.

Tracker UI: in src/components/TaskRow.tsx add a leading <input type=checkbox> bound to completedTaskIds.has(task.id) (rendered only when signed in) calling markTaskDone/unmarkTaskDone; a completed row uses --task-done dim + line-through plus the checkbox state and sr-only '(done)'. In src/components/TaskList.tsx add the All / My-unfinished / My-finished segmented filter (shown only when signed in) deriving from completedTaskIds, and thread completedTaskIds + handlers to TaskRow.

Glow swap: replace subjectHasPending with subjectGlows(subjectId, tasks, viewer) in ScheduleGrid/ScheduleCell, deriving viewer from useSession + the completion set from useTaskCompletions (wired in Layout).

Month calendar: create src/components/BoardViewToggle.tsx ('Weekly schedule | Month calendar' segmented toggle; state in Layout; details panel + right list unchanged). Create src/components/MonthCalendar.tsx rendering buildMonthGrid as a 7-col Monday-first grid of focusable real <button> day cells (Enter/Space activate, --focus-ring), up to 3 EventBadge/task chips + '+N more' via visibleWithOverflow, prev/next/Today controls, isToday highlight, signed-in finished tasks dimmed via --task-done, click-a-day surfaces that day's items in DetailsPanel; responsive dots-per-day + below-list at the mobile breakpoint via a base.css media query (not JS). Layout renders ScheduleGrid or MonthCalendar per the toggle and feeds the clicked-day items to DetailsPanel; extend src/components/DetailsPanel.tsx to render a selected day's merged items.

Update co-located tests: TaskList.test.tsx and ScheduleCell.test.tsx for the merged-list shape, the completion checkbox, the viewer-dependent glow, and the assessment badge, preserving existing behavioral assertions.
acceptance_criteria: An officer-only Add Event control exists and addEvent/updateEvent/removeEvent go through mutations.ts trusting RLS; events render in the right-hand list with a type badge (icon + text, not color-only).

A signed-in user can toggle a task done/not-done via the checkbox with optimistic update; the row dims + strikes through with sr-only '(done)'; the All/My-unfinished/My-finished filter works; tasks.status is never written by this path.
subjectGlows drives the schedule glow (viewer-dependent) and ScheduleCell shows the distinct upcoming-assessment badge within 7 days.

The Board shows a Weekly | Month toggle; the month grid shows tasks on deadline date and events on event date as chips, '+N more' past 3, today highlighted, prev/next/Today work, finished tasks dimmed, day cells keyboard-activatable, clicking a day lists its items in DetailsPanel.
useRealtimeTable's base id-keyed behavior and tests are unchanged.
verification: Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test` and confirm both pass, including the updated TaskList.test.tsx / ScheduleCell.test.tsx and the new useTaskCompletions.test.ts.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm it passes.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds.
